name: @koma-rig/workspace
description: Koma Live · 分层 2D 活立绘创作与实时 WebGL 驱动平台（内置 Koma Rig 绑骨底盘）

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/rig-core packages/rig-renderer && npm run typecheck -w @koma-rig/rig-studio
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:studio
scripts.build:studio: tsc -b packages/rig-core packages/rig-renderer && npm run build -w @koma-rig/rig-studio
scripts.test:live: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:studio && node --test tests/koma-live.browser.mjs
